author: Smith, Alexander D.
title: The languages of Borneo: A comprehensive classification
notes: Title page: May 2017. Chapter 2 gives, for each subgroup, tables of PMP reflexes in its member languages; a phoneme 'is not included in the sound correspondence table' where no language of the subgroup changed it (p. 50). Most data are the author's own fieldwork. The a/b/c suffixes on Smith 2017 are assigned in this database (alphabetical by title); Smith's own lists differ.
publisher: University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa dissertation

author: Smith, Alexander D.
title: Merap historical phonology in the context of a central Bornean linguistic area
notes: Merap (Langap village, Malinau River) from the author's fieldwork; reconstructions are to Proto-Kayanic (p. 162).

author: Smith, Alexander D.
title: The Western Malayo-Polynesian problem
notes: Argues that Western Malayo-Polynesian is not a subgroup. No sound correspondences are entered from it.

author: Smith, Alexander D.
title: Evidence and models of linguistic relations: Subgroups, linkages, lexical innovations, and Borneo
notes: Argues that the lexical evidence for Greater North Borneo and the Barito-Basap linkage does not justify those groups. No sound correspondences are entered from it.

author: Smith, Alexander D.
title: Late Malayo-Polynesian: A new model of Austronesian linguistic relations
notes: Proposes a dialect network ('Late Malayo-Polynesian') in place of higher-order Malayo-Polynesian subgroups. No sound correspondences are entered from it.
